domains.name: AI & Machine Learning Systems
domains.description: Vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embedding indices, and low-latency inference.

domains.name: Algorithms & Data Structures
domains.description: B-Trees vs LSM-Trees, graph traversal, consistent hashing rings, and asymptotic time-space trade-offs.

domains.name: Distributed Concurrency & Multithreading
domains.description: Multithreading, CPU memory models, lock-free atomics, distributed locking, Redlock consensus, and reactive streams.

domains.name: Design Patterns
domains.description: GoF structural/behavioral patterns, circuit breakers, sagas, and transactional outbox patterns.

domains.name: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
domains.description: Layer 4/7 load balancing, container orchestration, distributed tracing, and high-availability SRE.

domains.name: Distributed Systems
domains.description: High-availability replication, event loops, quorum consensus, and horizontal database sharding.

domains.name: Security & Identity
domains.description: Zero-trust architecture, OAuth2 & OIDC identity delegation, mTLS cryptography, and defense-in-depth.

domains.name: Software Architecture
domains.description: Decoupled event streaming, microservice resilience, CQRS, and domain-driven design.

domains.name: Software Engineering
domains.description: Clean code craft, automated testing pyramids, CI/CD pipelines, refactoring, and technical debt.

domains.name: System Design
domains.description: Learn the building blocks, then work through systems and company cases across 18 chapters and 200 learning units.

domains.name: Data Engineering & Spark Systems
domains.description: Apache Spark internals, Structured Streaming watermarking, open Lakehouse table formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), and Medallion architectures.

domains.name: Apache Kafka
domains.description: Understand append-only partitioned logs, consumer group rebalancing, ISR replication, and exactly-once semantics from first principles.
topics: Topics, partitions, and sequential disk I/O
Consumer lag, hot partitions & exactly-once myths

domains.name: Kubernetes
domains.description: Learn how Kubernetes reconciles desired state through etcd, the API server, scheduler, kubelet, Services, and readiness probes.
topics: Readiness vs. Liveness probes & graceful shutdown

domains.name: Large Language Models (LLM)
domains.description: Understand Transformer self-attention, BPE tokenization, KV-cache memory math, prefill vs. decode bottlenecks, and production serving.
topics: Prefill vs. Decode, TTFT, TPOT & KV Cache

domains.name: NoSQL Databases
domains.description: Understand document, key-value, and wide-column LSM-Tree databases—partition keys, tunable quorums, and access-pattern modeling.
topics: Partition keys, sort keys & query-driven modeling

domains.name: Redis
domains.description: Master Redis's single-threaded event loop, core data structures, Lua atomicity, eviction policies, and high-availability patterns.
topics: RDB vs AOF, eviction policies & Redis Cluster
Hot keys, cache stampede & big-key deletion

domains.name: SQL & Relational Databases
domains.description: Master relational modeling, B+Tree indexes, MVCC isolation, query execution plans, and scaling patterns for PostgreSQL and MySQL.
topics: B+Tree indexes, leftmost prefix & covering indexes

domains.name: Time-Series Databases
domains.description: Learn how time-series engines achieve 10x+ compression and millions of writes/sec using time-partitioned chunks, Gorilla/Delta encoding, and downsampling.
topics: Append-mostly streams, tags vs. fields & time chunks
Delta-of-Delta timestamps & Gorilla XOR float compression
